messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 PAGING: p99 latency spike detected on inference-prod-streaming (SLO p99 500ms -> observed 2.3s). Alert: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alerts/1767771234

sarah: I'm on it — grabbing traces. Are customers impacted? Any pages? :eyes:

customer-success: We received an automated notice and one SOC customer opened a ticket reporting degraded interactive responses ~15m ago. No formal PD page yet.

ivan: quick check of logs + traces: continuous packer queue depth climbed and packer assemble latency correlates with p99. Sample lines: 

```txt
2026-03-15T10:12:45Z packer: assembled batch=64 seq_len_mean=18 seq_len_sd=92 assemble_ms=1200
2026-03-15T10:12:46Z scheduler: defer_for_streaming=120ms
```

maya: seq_len_sd 92 is massive. Looks like a couple of very long requests got mixed into streaming batches with lots of short requests — packer doesn't preempt for long rows today.

raj: immediate mitigation suggestion: reduce max_pack_size and bias scheduler toward small requests. We can hot-flip max_pack_size -> 16 on the streaming pool. I can kick that if folks agree.

sarah: do it. Also let's avoid global rolling restarts. Hot-config only.

ops-bot: deploybot: rolling config update to pool 'streaming-prod-usw2' initiated by raj (@raj) — change: max_pack_size 64 -> 16. Strategy: gradual ramp, 3 steps.

ivan: concurrently seeing KV-cache growth on the same workers — memory pressure causing paging thrash for the packer threads. Proposing an eviction of idle KV entries >15m. Running eviction script now.

maya: added small_batch_priority toggle to the running config to prefer not packing small streaming requests with large ones. Config snippet below: 

```yaml
scheduler:
  small_batch_priority: true
  max_pack_size: 16
  preempt_threshold_ms: 100
```

ops-bot: deploybot: config rollout step 1 succeeded. Step 2 in progress.

sarah: after step1: p99 fell from 2.3s -> 780ms, p95 unchanged. Continuing rollout. Graph: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/d/xyz/streaming-latency

ops-bot: deploybot: config rollout complete. No errors reported.

sarah: post-rollout numbers: p99 now 420ms, p95 120ms. Customer-success: can you validate end-user experience? :white_check_mark:

customer-success: confirmed via SOC contact — interactive latency back to normal. They reported a ~20m window of degradation but now okay. They appreciate the quick response.

raj: follow-ups: 1) add mixed-seqlen synthetic tests, 2) create a canary that injects a 1024-token request every 5 minutes to test packer isolation, 3) add alert for seq_len_sd spike. I'll open tickets.

maya: created ticket INF-2026 with reproduction steps and tuning matrix. Assigned to eng-runtime and marked P2. Link: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INF-2026

sarah: notes for handoff: hot-config changes made: max_pack_size set to 16 on streaming-prod-usw2, small_batch_priority enabled, KV idle eviction set to 15m. Watch p99 and seq_len_sd for the next 6 hours.

ops-bot: pagerduty: oncall handoff scheduled at 1767774000 — sarah -> ivan.

sarah: handing off now. Ping me if it resurfaces. :v:

end
